scene_summary: Storm-dark abandoned facade plate: a cropped brick slab on the left, two weathered gables in the center, a low concrete/plywood wing on the right, chain-link rust seam across the lower third, wet street reflection below. The useful interaction anchors are real apertures, boards, siding scars, brick interruptions, fence knots, and black voids embedded in the image.

complexity_assessment.rationale: The plate has a strong readable structure—brick slab, twin gables, right wing, fence seam, storm sky—but many windows, boards, wires, and siding scars create dense detail. It remains expressionist and navigable if mappings stay pinned to real apertures and knots rather than broad facade zones.
